prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Design Your Pet's Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop pet a official name and claim your adoption record.", "Sign Certificate"]
1: ["Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick reference guide to control, interact with, or minimize your new desktop friend.", "Got It", "Click pet to open chat window", "Right-click pet for instant actions & settings", "Use System Tray to hide or summon pet anytime"]
2: []
3: ["Preparing Your Companion's New Home", "Setting up desktop behaviors, animations, and sound effects...", "Building pet assets...", "Generating companion"]
4: ["Takes under 2 minutes to complete your pet companion creation."]
5: ["We'll Notify You When Ready", "Feel free to use other apps. We will send a quick desktop notification when your pet arrives."]
6: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud", "Sign in with your primary account to ensure your pet progress and settings are safely synced and recoverable.", "Using the same login keeps your pet consistent across all your desktop devices."]
7: ["Official Adoption Seal"]
8: ["Desktop Pet Tips"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Adopt an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop display, reacts to your daily workflow, and keeps you company.", "Meet Companions"]
